Tail latency is the time from when a request is received until it's processed, which could be affected by queueing delays. Cache transfer is about moving data between cache and main memory, which affects speed and performance. Role switching might involve switching between different components or layers in the cluster. Batch completion refers to how long it takes to process a batch of requests, and GPU utilization is how much GPU is being used. Throughput tradeoffs are about balancing between processing speed and efficiency.
